announcements.headline: Publication of an Offer Document and Relevant Related Party Transaction Offer for Subscription
announcements.insight: Following the August fundraise intention, the publication of an offer document for subscription represents a significant capital raising step for shareholders.

announcements.headline: Board Changes
announcements.insight: Board changes follow the AGM results. Shareholders should monitor how this governance update aligns with the earlier intention to fundraise.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: The AGM results confirm shareholder approval of the Intention to Fundraise announced in August. This validates the capital raising process initiated earlier.

announcements.headline: Intention to Fundraise
announcements.insight: Foresight Technology VCT PLC intends to fundraise following its July 2026 final results. Shareholders should monitor for details on capital raising terms.

announcements.headline: Final Results
announcements.insight: Foresight Technology VCT PLC has released its final results. Shareholders should review these figures for performance indicators.
